model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the sensitivity of two quantization methods, 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit, across various block indices. The horizontal axis represents the Block Index, with values ranging from 0 to 79, marked at regular intervals. The vertical axis represents Sensitivity, with a logarithmic scale spanning from $10^{-6}$ to $10^{-4}$. The chart features two sets of bars, one for 2-Fbit and one for 4-Fbit, each with a distinct color, green and blue, respectively. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and they are not sorted in a specific order. There is no visual emphasis on any of the bars. The 2-Fbit bars generally have lower sensitivity values, ranging approximately from  $10^{-6}$ to slightly below $10^{-5}$, while the 4-Fbit bars have higher sensitivity values, ranging approximately from just above $10^{-6}$ to just above $10^{-4}$. Representative values from the shortest and tallest bars for 2-Fbit are around $10^{-6}$ and $10^{-5}$, respectively, and for 4-Fbit are around $10^{-6}$ and $10^{-4}$, respectively.
